title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a user can successfully register with valid email, password, and profile information and is redirected to the main app.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup page.
Enter a valid email address, strong password, and complete required profile details.
Submit the registration form.
Check the user account is created and email is verified (if applicable).
Verify the user is redirected to the main chat interface.

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Check login functionality with valid email and password results in a successful session and entry into the chat app.

steps.description: Go to the login page.
Input a registered email and corresponding password.
Click the login button.
Confirm that login is successful and user is redirected to the chat interface.

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify error handling and appropriate error messages display when entering invalid email or password during login.

steps.description: Open the login page.
Enter an unregistered email or incorrect password.
Click on login.
Check that login fails and a relevant error message appears.

title: Profile Editing and Avatar Upload
description: Test that a logged-in user can edit profile information including uploading an avatar image with validation.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the profile edit page.
Change profile fields such as display name and upload a valid avatar image file.
Save the changes.
Verify updated profile data is persisted and avatar is displayed correctly.
Attempt to upload invalid avatar file format (e.g., .exe or too large).
Confirm proper error handling and rejection of invalid files.

title: Real-time Text Messaging Between Two Users
description: Verify sending and receiving plain text messages in real-time between two different users with less than 1 second latency.

steps.description: User A logs in and opens chat with User B.
User B logs in on another device or browser and opens chat with User A.
User A sends a text message to User B.
Confirm User B receives the message within 1 second.
User B replies with a text message.
Confirm User A receives reply instantly.

title: Sending and Receiving Multimedia Messages
description: Test sending images, files, voice messages, locations, and contacts in chat and receiving them correctly with previews where applicable.

steps.description: Open a chat conversation.
Send an image file and verify it uploads and preview is shown before sending.
Ensure the recipient receives the image and can view/download it.
Send a document file and confirm upload progress is visible.
Recipient can download the document successfully.
Send a voice recording and share current location.
Receiver can play voice message and view shared location on map.
Share a contact from user's contact list.
Recipient can add shared contact easily via provided information.

title: Peer-to-Peer Voice Call Establishment and Controls
description: Verify that two users can initiate a peer-to-peer voice call, connection is established within 3 seconds, and call controls (mute, hang up) function properly.

steps.description: User A initiates a voice call to User B via the chat interface.
User B receives call notification and accepts the call.
Confirm voice connection is established within 3 seconds.
User A mutes microphone using call control UI.
Verify User B cannot hear User A's voice while muted.
User A ends the call using the hang-up button.
Confirm call terminates cleanly on both sides.

title: Peer-to-Peer Video Call Establishment and Controls
description: Validate video call connection is established properly, video streams are shown, and call controls such as camera on/off and hang up operate correctly.

steps.description: User A starts a video call to User B.
User B accepts video call request.
Verify video streams are displayed for both users promptly.
User B turns off camera using call controls.
Confirm User A no longer sees User B's video feed but call audio continues.
User B turns camera on again.
Verify User A receives video feed again.
Either user ends the video call.
Confirm call disconnects for both users.

title: Adding a Contact via AMIK ID Search
description: Test the ability to search for a user by AMIK ID, send a contact request, and receive proper notifications.

steps.description: User A navigates to contacts add/search page.
Search for User B by entering their AMIK ID.
User B's profile is found and displayed.
User A sends a contact request to User B.
User B receives a notification for the contact request.

title: Accepting and Rejecting Contact Requests
description: Verify that contact requests can be accepted or rejected, updating contact lists mutually and sending appropriate notifications.

steps.description: User B views received contact requests.
User B accepts a contact request from User A.
User A and User B are added mutually to each other's contacts.
User B rejects another contact request.
Requester is notified of rejection and no mutual contact is created.

title: Adding Contact via QR Code Scanner
description: Ensure the QR code scanner correctly scans a valid AMIK QR code, allowing users to add contacts efficiently.

steps.description: User opens the QR code scanner mini-program within the app.
Scan a valid contact QR code containing another user’s AMIK ID.
Display contact info extracted from QR code and option to send contact request.
Send contact request from the scanned QR code contact.
Confirm contact request is sent and notification received.

title: Automatic English to Urdu Message Translation
description: Validate AI-powered message translation feature performs automatic translation from English to Urdu with fallback dictionary usage upon failure.

steps.description: Send a message in English to a bilingual-enabled chat.
Confirm the message is automatically translated to Urdu for the recipient.
Simulate translation API failure or unrecognized phrases.
Verify fallback dictionary translations are used and displayed appropriately.
Send a message originally in Urdu.
Confirm translation direction and accuracy from Urdu to English if applicable.

title: File Upload and Progress Display
description: Test uploading various supported file types in chat with upload progress bar and preview, ensuring successful sending and receiving.

steps.description: Open chat and select 'attach file'.
Upload image, document, audio, and video files individually.
Upload progress is displayed accurately for each file.
Preview is available prior to sending for image and video files.
Send each file successfully.
Recipient receives files and can preview or download them without errors.

title: Drag-and-Drop File Upload Functionality
description: Verify drag-and-drop file input works correctly within chat, supporting multiple files and showing previews before sending.

steps.description: Drag one or more valid files into the chat input area.
Files appear in the preview pane with thumbnails where applicable.
Send files to recipient.
Confirm recipient receives all files correctly and can access them.

title: QR Code Generation and Styling
description: Test correct generation of styled QR codes representing user AMIK IDs and validate scanning by others adds contact correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to user profile to generate personal AMIK QR code.
Verify generated QR code includes accurate AMIK ID data and visual styling matches design.
Use different devices or apps to scan the QR code.
Confirm scanned QR code data is valid and allows adding user as contact.

title: Mini-Programs Launch and Operation
description: Verify mini-programs such as AI agents and QR code scanner launch correctly within the app environment and function as intended.

steps.description: Open the mini-programs section within the app.
Launch AI agent mini-program and interact with it.
Confirm AI agent responds correctly and integration is stable.
Open QR code scanner mini-program and scan multiple sample codes.
Check scanning results are accurate and consistent.

title: Message Deletion and Privacy Controls
description: Validate users can delete messages with correct options (single message, conversation) and that privacy settings are enforced across sessions.

steps.description: Send multiple messages in a chat.
Delete a single message and observe effects on sender's and receiver's chat.
Deleted message is removed correctly and replaced with deletion indicator or removed completely.
Delete an entire conversation history.
Confirm conversation is cleared locally as per privacy controls without affecting the other user’s chat data.
Change privacy settings for profile visibility and session management.
Verify settings persist and enforce rules such as blocking users or session expiry.

title: Cross-browser and Device Responsive UI Testing
description: Ensure the web application UI renders and functions consistently across major desktop and mobile browsers with responsive layout.

steps.description: Open AMIK CHAT on latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge on desktop.
Verify UI layout, components, and interactions work without major issues.
Access the app on iOS Safari and Android Chrome mobile browsers.
Confirm responsive design adjusts UI properly and functionality is intact.
Resize browser windows to test responsive breakpoints.
Validate no overlapping, missing components, or usability problems occur.
